audit.why: diff EVEN / 6/10 with carry threat 7/10 is a fair read: Kennen owns levels 2 through the first item, Swain owns the two-item duel. The 60.23% win rate comes from the late side of that curve, not from lane dominance, so I did not inflate the rating.
audit.corrected: No change to diff, diffRating or carryRating.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart on disk reads Skill/Kennen/Kennen/Skill/Skill/Kennen/Kennen, but its own whys say Kennen owns Levels 4-5 and Level 6 and that Swain wins the two-item fight. The mirror already flipped rows 3 and 4 to Kennen and row 6 to Swain.
audit.why: whys[3] describes Kennen owning the lane geometry; whys[4] gives him the level-6 edge; whys[6] and spikes[3] both say Swain wins the extended two-item drain fight.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 and 4 to Kennen, row 6 to Swain, proposed as matched full+content pairs, ratings adjusted.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and spikes[1] say Kennen 'pops R, goes untargetable' and that the stun 'fires through your Demonic Ascension channel'. Neither is supportable, and no cooldown numbers appear anywhere.
audit.why: Riot text: Slicing Maelstrom is a 120s, 550-range storm that strikes nearby champions — no untargetability. The untargetability in that sentence is Zhonya's stasis, a separate item. Demonic Ascension is a transformation, not a channel. What is real: the storm keeps applying Mark of the Storm, and the third Mark stuns via his passive. Lightning Rush is 10/9/8/7/6s and Electrical Surge 13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6s.
audit.corrected: Untargetability attributed to Zhonya's, the channel claim dropped, and the Mark-stacking mechanic plus real cooldowns written into whys[4], spikes[1], wants.foe[1], breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], dosFull[0].d and phases[3]/[4]/[6].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells you to build MR and stops there.
audit.why: Electrical Surge applies on-hit, so his damage scales with attack speed as well as AP — MR alone misreads the extended trade.
Both packet suspectNames ('Save Slicing Maelstrom', 'His Slicing Maelstrom') are false positives — the ability name is spelled correctly in both places; the matcher caught the leading verb.
audit.corrected: No name change needed. wants.foe[1] is still rewritten, but for its untargetability error, not its name.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Lightning Rush's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: He owns the lane geometry: Lightning Rush is down to 7s by rank 4, so he stacks Marks and leaves before your E sweeps back.

edits.before: Demonic Ascension turns his all-in into your healing — bait it, then drain. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kennen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom is 120s and its repeat hits stack Marks into a stun — do not stand in it to drain; leave the nova, re-enter after.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Kennen carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: fragment bulk plus near-permanent drain outlasts his burst — take the solo duel, refuse the grouped R.

edits.before: - Kennen Lightning Rush: matchup-defining — His escape. E-root when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Lightning Rush: 10s at rank 1, 6s at rank 5 — his in-and-out, so root on the way back. - Electrical Surge: 13s to 6s, applies on-hit, and it adds the Mark. - Slicing Maelstrom: 120s, same as your Demonic Ascension.

edits.before: Track Kennen's Lightning Rush: His escape. E-root when it’s down. When it is down — E-root + R him.
edits.after: Lightning Rush is 10s at rank 1 and 6s at rank 5 — root him on Nevermove's return, pull, then drain.

edits.before: His escape. E-root when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His in-and-out, 10s at rank 1 down to 6s. Engage once it is spent.

edits.before: E-root Kennen's step-up when his answer is down, right-click to drag the soul fragment, and Q the stacked wave-trade.
edits.after: Merc Treads and MR blunt his Q, but Electrical Surge applies on-hit — attack speed drives his trades, not just AP.

edits.before: His Slicing Maelstrom plus Zhonya's Hourglass is a complete defensive package at level six: he pops R, goes untargetable, and the stun fires through your Demonic Ascension channel — edge stays with him.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom plus Zhonya's is a complete package at six: the storm keeps re-marking you until the third Mark stuns, and Zhonya's stasis rides out your drain — the edge stays with him.

edits.before: Kennen's Slicing Maelstrom into Zhonya's Hourglass is a full reset — he pops R, goes untargetable, and you cannot pull him or land Demonflare while he is golden.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom into Zhonya's is a full reset — the storm re-marks you for the stun while stasis makes him untouchable, so you cannot pull him or land Demonflare.

edits.before: Save Slicing Maelstrom (R) and Zhonya's Hourglass for the exact moment Demonic Ascension activates so the stun fires while you are untargetable
edits.after: Save Slicing Maelstrom (R) and Zhonya's Hourglass for the exact moment Demonic Ascension activates, so the third Mark stuns you mid-drain

notes: Row 6 goes to Swain, not the packet's 'Skill' — that is the mirror's resolution and it matches whys[6] and spikes[3], which both describe Swain winning the two-item extended fight. Both packet suspectNames are false positives. The claim that Kennen's R itself grants untargetability appeared twice and was Zhonya's stasis being credited to the ultimate; corrected rather than deleted.
